enchantments.tooltip: +14 Enhancement Bonus: +14 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Bleeding 6: This weapon is wickedly curved, with spines and hooks meant to cause damage to those with flesh. This weapon does 6d8 bleeding damage to those that are vulnerable to it.
Gashing 14: The edges of this weapon are sharpened beyond belief, dealing an additional 14d6 slashing damage on each critical hit.
Slashing 6: The edges of this weapon are sharpened, dealing an additional 6d6 slashing damage on each hit.
Armor-Piercing 21%: Passive: +21% Enhancement bonus to Fortification Bypass. (Fortification Bypass makes your attacks ignore a percentage of enemy Fortification.)
